summary:
Earth JS Jukebox Sonification is an advanced, multi-tier web application developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge by Team Meta Beats.

The platform bridges complex earth-science telemetry with human perception by translating official NASA satellite observation data into real-time, polyphonic acoustic soundscapes and hardware-accelerated 3D WebGL visualizations.

Core Project Pillars
3-Tier Architecture: Built on a clean, scalable stack featuring a responsive Frontend HUD (Three.js 3D Earth & Moon orbit), a Node.js/Express Backend REST API, and a Memory Archive housing certified NASA JSON datasets.

5-Channel Web Audio DSP Synthesizer: Dynamically maps satellite metrics (precipitation, ocean heat anomalies, and ice mass loss) into live harmonic leads, sub-bass drones, weather ambience, and anomaly sirens.

NASA-Certified Historical Datasets:

Disc 01 (Rain): 12-month South Asian monsoon cycle via GPM IMERG & MERRA-2.

Disc 02 (Ocean): 10-year Indian Ocean thermal swell & sea-level rise via MODIS Aqua & Sentinel-6.

Disc 03 (Glacier): 25-year polar ice sheet mass loss (-3,420 Gt total loss) via GRACE, GRACE-FO & ICESat-2.

Interactive & Export Tools: Includes a 15-key harmonic synth keyboard, a 16-step telemetry drum sequencer, touch-interactive globe shockwaves, and an automated jsPDF scientific report generator.

🌍 EARTH JS JUKEBOX SONIFICATION // COMPLETE PROJECT BREAKDOWN

NASA Space Apps Challenge Hackathon Project

Team Name: Meta Beats

Lead System Architect & Main Developer: Shivam Raj

🚀 Executive Summary

Earth JS Jukebox Sonification is an advanced, multi-tier web application that bridges complex Earth-science telemetry with human perception. By transforming official NASA satellite observation records into real-time polyphonic acoustic soundscapes and immersive hardware-accelerated 3D WebGL visualizations, the application allows users and judges to "listen" to climate evolution across precipitation, ocean thermal swell, and polar ice sheet mass loss.

🏛️ 3-Tier System Architecture

The project is structured around a clean, modular 3-tier architecture designed for low-latency browser performance and scalable server routing:

Tier

Component

Description

Tier 1

Frontend Engine (1-frontend/)

Interactive HUD UI, Three.js 3D Earth & Orbiting Moon stage, 5-channel Web Audio DSP synthesizer, 15-key harmonic keyboard, and jsPDF report generator.

Tier 2

Backend API (2-backend/)

Lightweight Node.js and Express server routing /data/:track REST endpoints to serve normalized satellite time-series data.

Tier 3

Memory Archive (3-memory/)

NASA-certified historical JSON time-series datasets (rain.json, ocean.json, glacier.json) containing multi-epoch scientific metrics and physical mechanisms.

📀 The 3 NASA Scientific Discs & Datasets

🌧️ Disc 01: Atmospheric Rain & Monsoon (2025)

  • Source: NASA GPM IMERG v07B & NASA POWER MERRA-2 Reanalysis.
  • Scope: 1-year monthly cycle (Jan–Dec 2025) tracking South Asian monsoon thermodynamic progression.
  • Acoustic Mapping: Crystal pluck arpeggio combined with procedural monsoon white-noise static.

🌊 Disc 02: Indian Ocean Thermal Swell (2016–2025)

  • Source: NASA MODIS Aqua SST, Jason-3 & Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich Altimetry.
  • Scope: 10 landmark years tracking regional sea-level rise (+79mm to +112mm) and marine heatwave anomalies.
  • Acoustic Mapping: Deep FM pad chords with ocean filter sweeps and wave modulation.

🧊 Disc 03: Antarctic & Polar Ice Loss (2001–2025)

  • Source: NASA GRACE, GRACE-FO Satellite Gravimetry & ICESat-2 Laser Altimetry.
  • Scope: 25 consecutive years tracking cumulative polar ice sheet mass balance down to -3,420 Gigatonnes.
  • Acoustic Mapping: Sub-bass cryo drone coupled with glacier fracture transients and anomaly sirens.

⚙️ Key Technical Features

  1. 3D Planetary WebGL Stage: Hardware-accelerated Three.js rendering featuring a rotating Earth, plasma atmosphere halo, low-earth orbit satellite ring, and a fully orbital 3D Lunar Moon.
  2. 5-Channel Web Audio DSP Synthesizer: Real-time mixing rack with independent control over Harmonic Lead Synth, Deep Sub-Bass Drone, Procedural Weather FX, 808 Kick Percussion, and Anomaly Sirens, backed by a 60FPS FFT spectrum analyzer and oscilloscope.
  3. Smart Voice-Sync Pipeline: Asynchronous browser SpeechSynthesis integration with completion callbacks to ensure scientific narration never cuts off prematurely during playback.
  4. Automated PDF Scientific Dossier Generator: Built-in jsPDF export tool enabling judges to download a comprehensive report complete with physical mechanisms, sonification formulas, and date-by-date telemetry archives.
